d.ko:
Forge your weapon and follow the path of the Jedi

Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy is the latest installment of the highly acclaimed Jedi Knight series. Take on the role of a new student eager to learn the ways of the Force from Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. Interact with famous Star Wars characters in many classic Star Wars locations as you face the ultimate choice: fight for good and freedom on the light side or follow the path of power and evil to the dark side.

rv.t: 예전 컴으로 해본 제다이 아카데미... 스타워즈 주인공이 된거 처럼 광선검이나 포스로 적을 제압하는 재미가 있었다
어릴때 본 스타워즈 광선검 붕쯔붕쯔의 로망을 충실히 실현해주는 멋진 무브셋의 기술일람표 근데 어디로 가는건지 알 수가 없네? 길찾기가 아니야 이 겜에 '길' 이라는 개념이 없는거같어;;

This is Star Wars at its most fun. Lightsaber combat, force powers, and the freedom to just mess around with everything. It might feel old, but the core gameplay still hits. Simple, chaotic, and timeless Man. I love star wars.

This is a classic that has aged incredibly well. I still remembered specific maps, cutscenes, and characters after over 20 years, they are just that iconic. OG, pre-disney star wars really was magical.

This game is supposed to work with a controller, and I guess it does in the most basic sense. However, although the game registers the inputs, you are left trying to map over a dozen buttons manually. …
